name: Telegram Referral Bot
description: A Telegram bot that incentivizes user growth through a point-based referral system.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org

DATABASE_NAME.description: The name of the database for storing bot data

ADMIN_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID (to receive redemption notifications)

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Your Telegram Username (without @) for users to contact you

FSUB_CHANNELS.description: Space-separated channel usernames users must join (e.g., @Channel1 @Channel2)

WEB_SERVER.description: Set to True for hosting on platforms like Render/Koyeb

PING_URL.description: Optional: The URL of this bot for keeping it alive (Render/Koyeb)

PING_TIME.description: Interval (in seconds) to ping the bot
